title: TREND: Unsupervised 3D Representation Learning via Temporal Forecasting for LiDAR Perception

layout.note: Three lettered pipelines in a 2x2 grid: (a) top-left, (b) top-right, (c) as a wider bottom row; the fourth cell holds the small legend. Each pipeline reads left to right as input scan, backbone block, target, with its bold title under it.

lesson: Compare pretext tasks by drawing each as the same three-part chain (input, backbone, target) on the same real example, with the proposed one last, wider and tinted blue, so the reader sees only the target change.
